findings.evidence: The 22-line Workflow section and six-line tokens, consistency, a11y and interaction sections are predominantly activation: approximately 46 of 124 H2-section lines. Examples include "find the theme first", "reuse the shared component" and "every action is keyboard-operable". The custom evidence rules and framework-specific traps add substantially more knowledge than these familiar reminders.
findings.fix: Condense the familiar theme, request-state and shared-control preflight reminders into one ordered checklist. Preserve the eight pass lines, custom exceptions, evidence routing and non-obvious framework/live-region gotchas rather than repeating general UI advice around them.

findings.evidence: The source-and-render branch says "nothing: decide every row", and the source-only branch says "loading, hierarchy, tokens, consistency and states never need a render". However, loading requires "CLS stays at 0.1 or less" at line 34. Source plus one desktop screenshot does not necessarily establish layout shift, missing viewport behavior or unobserved interaction states; source alone cannot establish runtime CLS.
findings.fix: Apply evidence-sufficiency checks to every input combination. Fail proven violations, pass only when all applicable criteria are established, and otherwise use na with the missing observation identified. Remove the blanket claim that loading never needs runtime evidence, and explicitly allow unverified CLS or timing checks.

findings.evidence: Build preflight says "set no fixed container width", and the responsive Trap also treats "Fixed container widths" as defects without qualification. This rejects safe constrained layouts such as width: 20rem; max-width: 100%, even when they reflow correctly and keep the primary action reachable.
findings.fix: Make fluid sizing the default, but permit fixed preferred widths constrained by max-width, wrapping or breakpoint changes. Fail widths when they cause page-level overflow or an unreachable primary action, rather than failing every fixed-width declaration.
